title: Polynomial G-ring completion comparison
statement: For a G-ring R and a maximal ideal Q of R[X], there is a flat local comparison map into a Noetherian local ring whose composite with completion is regular.

proof.text: Contract Q to p in R and replace R by R_p. Identify the polynomial localization with R[X]_Q. Complete R_p and choose Q prime over Q in its completed polynomial ring using the common residue field; this prime is maximal and contracts to the maximal ideal. Localize the base change of the regular map R_p to its completion, obtaining a regular flat local comparison map to B.

The completion of R_p is Noetherian complete local. The complete-local polynomial formal-fibre theorem makes B to its completion regular. Composite fibres are quotients of localizations of a Noetherian completion, so regular composition gives the required regular composite.

lean.statement: theorem exists_polynomial_flat_local_regular_completion_comparison (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (hR : IsGRing R) (Q : Ideal (Polynomial R)) [Q.IsMaximal] : ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (_ : IsNoetherianRing B), ∃ φ : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* B, φ.Flat ∧ (∀ x : Localization.AtPrime Q, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) → φ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧ ((algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B)).comp φ).IsRegular
